answer: Sybil resistance follows because reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, verified honest service to retain weight. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted incoming mass and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot manufacture support without credible paths. Names such as reef, yarrow, and falcon add no evidence, so these identities cannot reach consensus thresholds.
